rules.text: context {ctxPct}% — /compact now or start a fresh session
context {ctxPct}% — /compact soon, or /clear if this thread is done
merge conflicts unresolved — fix before asking for more edits
PR has changes requested — /code-review the diff before pushing again
5h limit {rate5h}% — drop /effort or switch model to stretch the window
weekly limit {rateWeek}% — save Opus for the hard parts
prompt cache cold — next call re-sends the whole prefix
cache hits {cacheHit}% — editing CLAUDE.md or tools mid-session busts the prefix
{dirty} files dirty — commit a checkpoint before the next big change
{ahead} commits unpushed — push before the laptop decides otherwise
plan mode — shift+tab twice to execute once the plan reads right
bypass permissions on — every tool call runs unasked
session at {cost} — /cost for the breakdown, /clear to reset the context tax

tips: ctrl+r toggles full tool output
esc esc rewinds the conversation to an earlier turn
shift+tab cycles permission modes: default, accept-edits, plan
/effort max for the gnarly bugs, /effort low for mechanical edits
/compact with a sentence of guidance keeps what you care about
# at the start of a message writes it straight to memory
@ pulls a file into context without a tool call
/rewind restores files from an earlier checkpoint
! runs a shell command and drops the output into the thread
/resume reopens any past session in this directory
ctrl+b runs the current command in the background
/agents builds a subagent with its own tools and model
/hooks fires your own scripts before and after tool calls
/statusline rewrites this very line by describing what you want
/add-dir gives Claude a second directory to read
/mcp lists connected servers and their auth state
/export dumps the transcript to a file or clipboard
/privacy-settings controls what gets used for training
claude -p "..." runs one prompt headless and exits
claude --continue picks up the last session from your shell
CLAUDE.md in a subdirectory only loads when files there are touched
/doctor checks your install when something behaves oddly
a plan approved in plan mode survives /clear if you save it first
/vim turns on modal editing in the prompt
